title: Is GPT-4o mini Blinded by its Own Safety Filters? Exposing the Multimodal-to-Unimodal Bottleneck in Hate Speech Detection
reasoning: The paper investigates the technical architecture and failure modes of AI safety filters and hate speech detection (AI Alignment). While it mentions social biases and human values, its primary focus is on the multimodal architectural bottleneck rather than a systematic evaluation of religious doctrines, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks.
